info.name: Paylark Payments API
info.description:
The Paylark Payments API lets merchants accept online payments through a  
hosted payment page, follow each order through its payment lifecycle, and  
refund completed payments.

**About this sample:** Paylark is a fictional payment service provider (PSP)  
created for a documentation portfolio. Its design follows common PSP  
conventions: a redirect flow, order statuses, signed webhooks, and separate  
test and live environments.

Contact Support:  
Name: Santiago Fernández Ulibarri

request.description:
Creates an order and returns a `payment_url`. Redirect the customer to
that URL to pay on the Paylark hosted payment page.

`order_id` is your own reference and must be unique per order. If a
request times out, retry it with the same `order_id`: Paylark rejects
the duplicate with `409 Conflict` instead of creating a second order.

response.name: Order created. Redirect the customer to `payment_url`.
